headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 26, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a thrilling 2-1 victory over the Chicago Cubs, while the Baltimore Orioles edged out the Tampa Bay Rays 7-9. The Minnesota Twins fell short against the Chicago White Sox, and the St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 5-1 loss to the Milwaukee Brewers.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with Max Kranick being transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to his ongoing right elbow surgery recovery with the Washington Nationals. Other notable injuries include Dylan Cease (Toronto Blue Jays) with a left hamstring strain, Jose Quintana (Colorado Rockies) with a left elbow sprain, and Jonny DeLuca (Tampa Bay Rays) with a right hamstring strain.

The Colorado Rockies made a roster move ahead of their series, trading left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded right-handed pitcher Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds traded right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley to the Miami Marlins for right fielder Rece Hinds. The Tampa Bay Rays traded left-handed pitcher Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for third baseman Oliver Dunn.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cubs in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Chicago Cubs 2-1 in a closely contested game, securing their win. Michael Busch led the Cubs' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Ben Brown pitched 6 strong innings for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Orioles in Thrilling 7-9 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-9 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, handing the Rays their loss. Jonathan Aranda led the Rays' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 1-3 loss to the Chicago White Sox, with Drew Romo leading the Twins' offense. Romo hit a home run, his fifth of the season, to drive in two runs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Brewers in 5-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals were defeated by the Milwaukee Brewers with a final score of 5-1. Christian Yelich led the Brewers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals' Max Kranick Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals right-hander Max Kranick has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to his ongoing right elbow surgery recovery.

top_news.title: **Rockies Make Roster Move Ahead of Series**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash on May 25, 2026.
